description: Nepal (+977) and India (+91) phone number check: valid, mobile/landline, operator or region, E.164. Use to validate or normalise a Nepali or Indian phone number before saving or messaging it. Format rules only, no carrier lookup. Returns valid, type (mobile, landline, tollfree), operator (e.g. Nepal Telecom, Ncell), region, e164 and reason when invalid. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.
